features.title: 병원 진료 보기 — full real clinic visit flow at 광안 메디컬 의원 driven by the game's fatigue → illness system (번호표 → 접수 → 대기·호출 → 진료실 의사 상담·진단 → 처치/주사/수액 → 수납 → 약국) + 건강검진 코스 (GwangalliClinic)
features.research: Owner (Korean): "가게 병원 상호작용 가능해야한다 진료도 볼수 있어야하고" and: "우리 시스템중 알바로 직업 계속하면 피로도가 쌓이고 안 쉬어주고 계속 일하면 질병쪽으로 가게되서 병원 가게되는 원리임 이미. 시스템상 그렇게 구현되어 있잖아" = the game ALREADY has: working part-time jobs builds 피로도 (fatigue); not resting leads to 질병 (illness); illness is why players go to the hospital. The clinic flow MUST be driven by that real state. Research first, deeply: ServerScriptService/GwangalliGameplay/Health (header: '피로도 (fatigue) -> pay debuff -> 질병 (illness) -> 병원'; G.Attr.Illness player attribute, illKind, collapse, fees/debt '응급 진료비', '완치', fatigue reduction), ReplicatedStorage/GwangalliHealthShared (illness kinds: names/icons/symptoms/costs/thresholds — HS.kind), ReplicatedStorage/GwangalliGameplayShared (G.Attr, G.Remote, G.HEALTH config), client StarterPlayerScripts/GwangalliHealth (+ Chip) UI, how Jobs/JobShop/WorkPlacement add fatigue, how rest/sleep (Life.sleep, homes) lowers it, the existing hospital UI flow (HospitalPrompt desk/doctor → HealthEvent 'clinic'; HealthRequest RemoteFunction ops treat / vitamin / checkup with fees and choreography: Health.findBed, nurse Motor6D syringe pose with GwProp parts, doctor seated pose), Law/Hospital NPC actors (접수/의사/간호사/환자/보호자, SPOTS), KOSystem/Arms ward wake-up, the ATM 번호표 client pattern (GwangalliFeatures/ATM), GwangalliWorld/Screens (LEDScreen Messages), Bank, Profiles. Survey: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/bld/hospital_garage.json (hospital rooms, contracts, interactionIdeas). Also note 광안 종합병원 (runtime-built: GwangalliBuildings/Hospital + Builder/Hospital, ShopLife desks) and whether the flow can also run there cheaply. Another agent builds the client-only facility layer (GwangalliBuildingInterior/HospitalPlus + Hosp_*.luau: doors/elevator/restrooms) and T_clinic.luau dresses the rooms (static LED screens) — read them to place dynamic screens and avoid conflicts.
features.build:
Make 진료 보기 a real, fun, AAA clinic visit, built ON the existing Health system (never duplicate or bypass its fees/effects/cure logic — the real cure/fatigue reduction/payment must go through the existing Health ops):
0) State-driven: read the player's real 피로도 (Fatigue attribute) and 질병 (Illness attribute + HealthShared kind data) everywhere — the receptionist and doctor talk about the actual illness and its cause ('알바를 너무 오래 하셨네요… 과로로 인한 ○○입니다'), show symptoms from the kind data, recommend rest (휴식/수면 at home) per the system, and pick the right treatment; healthy players get 건강 상담 / 영양제 / 예방접종 / 건강검진 options. Show a 건강 상태 card (피로도 bar, 질병명, 원인, 권장 조치) on 접수 and in 진료실. Handle unpaid debt the way the system does.
1) 번호표 발권기 at the lobby kiosk: prompt → printed ticket pops out (client anim) with your number; server-side shared queue per 진료과 (내과 · 가정의학과 · 소아청소년과 · 예방접종 · 건강검진), visible to everyone; sick players (illness set) are routed to 내과 automatically with priority if severe.
2) LED call screens (lobby, waiting room, consult door): live '대기 N명 · 진료중 N번', '○○○님 (번호) 진료실 1로 들어오세요' with 딩동 chime; SurfaceGuis in PlayerGui adorned to the room's screen parts (prefer parts with attribute GwClinicScreen in Workspace.GwInteriorDetailLocal, else the map's LEDScreen parts in the hospital, else your own small screen parts in your own Workspace folder).
3) 접수 at the reception desk (receptionist NPC from Law/Hospital if present, else the desk): dialog with typing effect — 증상 확인 (pre-filled from the real illness), 진료과 배정, 대기 안내; waiting in the waiting room (sit on a waiting seat; magazine/TV/정수기 small interactions), time-scaled (~20–60 s, shorter when no one is ahead; urgent illness faster).
4) 진료실: when called, walk in; doctor dialog: 문진 tied to the real illness, 청진기/혈압 check mini-sequence (camera close-up, BP cuff tween, numbers derived from fatigue/illness), 진단 card (illness name/icon from HealthShared, cause '과로', 처방), treatment choice → 주사 · 수액 · 처방전 · 비타민/영양제 → call the existing Health ops (treat / vitamin / checkup) so fees and effects are real; the existing seated-doctor/nurse choreography plays; publish a '진료 중' attribute the facility layer can show over the consult door.
5) 처치실: 주사/수액 recliner flow with progress bar and nurse lines; 6) 수납: 진료비 영수증 UI (itemised in 원, matching what the Health op actually charged), 7) 약국: prescription → pharmacist hands a 약봉투 prop (client) with 복약 안내 + '충분히 쉬세요' advice.
8) 건강검진 코스 (2F 건강검진센터): stations — 신장·체중 (height rod), 혈압, 시력 (Landolt C arrows), 청력 부스 (beeps L/R), 심전도 (ECG line) → 결과지 UI with the real fatigue/illness summary; final step calls the existing HealthRequest 'checkup'.
9) Ward/rest: '병실 휴식' on a free ward bed via the existing safe path (and fatigue recovery only if the system supports it), 간호사 호출 버튼 chime + nurse lamp.
Server: shared queues/tickets/state with validation and rate limits, cleanup on leave; never break HospitalPrompt anchors/prompts, HospitalBed seats, staff rigs, NPC corridors, collapse/ambulance/ward flows. Korean UI, mobile-friendly, premium clinic look (teal/white).
